baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-4, with the paired endings in رَبِّكُمَا and تُكَذِّبَانِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Specified favors are placed under the pair's Lord-owner and submitted individually to a truth-status response; denial is an active declaration that a gift-claim is false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the concrete objects under interrogation.
Lordship and ownership make the favors answerable to a governing giver.
Declaring a report false makes the response active rejection rather than inattention.

changed_reading.after: A discriminating challenge: which particular bestowal of their governing Lord can the two responsibly declare false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 can activate capacity and shortfall, while words 3-4 support staged nurture and a charge that may fail.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord develops capacity stage by stage; the question tests whether the pair will withhold or fail to carry through what that nurture made possible. Denial becomes performative nonfulfillment as well as speech.

activation_trace.role: Capacity lets the questioned object include abilities made available to the pair.
Falling short supplies the negative response to granted capacity.
Repair, nurture, and completion provide the staged process forming capacity.
A charge proving false by failure turns denial into failure to enact an entrusted ability.

changed_reading.before: The pair merely says that favors are untrue.
changed_reading.after: The pair can falsify nurture by failing to actualize the capacities it has produced.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The three focus roots permit oath, pact, and failed-charge branches without leaving the syntax.
baseline_models.mechanism: An oath-like object under a covenant-making Lord is tested by whether the pair makes its corresponding charge true in conduct; the question can sound juridical alongside the favor reading.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch gives the questioned objects binding force.
A covenant or protection pact supplies the relation binding Lord and addressees.
A charge fulfilled or failed supplies the behavioral test of the covenant.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks only whether benefits are verbally denied.
changed_reading.after: It can also ask which binding claims of the Lord the pair will cause to fail in performance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching, disclosure, calculation, balance, and the prohibition on short-measuring form an epistemic-accounting chain before the first refrain. Denial can be distortion of an inspectable account: discounting what has been made knowable and measurable.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure makes the gifts available for recognition.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies the means for testing truth.
Counting and account turn celestial order into inspectable reckoning.
A justice-balance makes right measure the evaluative norm.
Short-changing measure models discounting evidence or favor.
Bestowed favors remain the focus objects whose measure is at issue.
Declaring false names the endpoint of distorted reckoning.

structural_cues: 55:1-12 moves through teaching, creation, explanation, celestial calculation, balance, anti-loss commands, and provisions before 55:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, account, balance, and short-measure images; I infer an arrow from under-measuring what is knowable to declaring it false. Simple ingratitude without this mechanism remains live.

changed_reading.after: Which disclosed and measurable entries in your Lord's provision will you falsify by counting them short?

context_deltas.mechanism: Fair measure and the later equivalence of good action with good return establish reciprocity. A following liability, covenant, and failed charge then make the refrain an account of response owed, not only benefits received.

activation_trace.role: A justice-balance supplies the norm governing reciprocal response.
Equity prevents the response from being reduced or skewed.
Defrauding measure models inadequate discharge of what is due.
Action met by recompense supplies the explicit reciprocal circuit.
Good-doing on both sides identifies the quality exchanged.
A following right lets favor carry a claim accompanying its holder.
The pact branch frames reciprocity as protected obligation.
A failed charge makes denial an underperformed response.

structural_cues: The first refrain follows commands about just measure, while the same refrain later follows the reciprocal question at 55:60.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fair measure, recompense, good-doing, a following claim, and a failed charge; I infer that received favor calls for proportionate acknowledgment in conduct. Non-transactional grace remains live.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a mistaken opinion about gifts.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be inequitable discharge of the response that received good places upon the pair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parallel origin clauses distinguish a manifest human order formed from sounding dry clay and a hidden jinn order formed from blazing fire. They retrospectively resolve the focus dual as two materially different constituencies answerable to one nurturing Lord.

activation_trace.role: Creation as proportioning makes each order a deliberately configured counterpart.
Manifest humanity contrasted with jinn identifies one side of the dual.
Dry resonant clay gives the human side an audible material signature.
Pottery completes the fired and formed human material image.
Hidden beings identify the second constituency.
Blazing fire gives the hidden side an origin unlike clay.
Stage-wise nurture holds both orders under one formative relation.
The dual declaration becomes a joint verdict across both orders.

structural_cues: 55:14 and 55:15 are parallel creation-from-material clauses, and 55:16 immediately repeats the focus sentence with dual endings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel origins, manifest/hidden contrast, and the immediate repeated dual; I infer that these identify the pair in 55:13. A generic dual audience remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The dual suffix is an unspecified grammatical pair.
changed_reading.after: Human and jinn, though made from contrasting materials and modes of visibility, are summoned as co-witnesses to one formative Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact sentence repeatedly follows new scenes, while a supplied non-dominant branch imagines one voice following another. Repetition activates the focus as an antiphonal hinge: disclosure is followed by question, and the paired audience is pressed to answer.

activation_trace.role: A voice following a voice supplies an antiphonal image for the first recurrence.
Following in sequence lets the focus occurrence inaugurate recurring hinges.
Declaring false supplies the possible answer contested by recurrence.

structural_cues: After 55:13 the same dual question recurs thirty times, normally after a fresh disclosure.
The recurring dual ending keeps the pair audible at each hinge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence and branches for sequence and answering voice; I infer responsorial performance. Emphatic rhetorical repetition without actual antiphony remains live.

changed_reading.after: 55:13 inaugurates a recurring call-and-response interface in which each scene demands a renewed paired answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The two seas meet across an interval without overreaching, and the two addressee classes cannot cross cosmic sides except with warranting power. Limit, interspace, and authorized passage become favors preserving relation without collapse.

activation_trace.role: A connection standing between parties makes the interval relational rather than empty.
Aggressive overstepping supplies the failure the boundary prevents.
Passing to the other side supplies the desired but conditioned crossing.
Compelling warrant supplies the condition for legitimate passage.
The favor branch admits protective limits among the questioned bestowals.
Lordly authority establishes and warrants the boundaries.

structural_cues: 55:19-20 juxtaposes meeting, an intervening barrier, and non-transgression.
55:33 invites jinn and humans to pass beyond heaven and earth but conditions passage on authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting, interspace, overreach, crossing, and warrant; I infer that bounded coexistence is itself benefaction. The limits may instead be demonstrations of power.

changed_reading.before: Favors are positive contents handed to recipients.
changed_reading.after: A favor may be the limit that keeps distinct powers in relation without permitting either to erase the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: Because the refrain follows extinction, abiding presence, fire, unmistakable recognition, visible marks, and seizure, its object class exceeds pleasant goods. Consequential warning and exposure can be lordly disclosure that blocks self-deception.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after continuance makes creaturely impermanence visible.
Abiding duration discloses where permanence belongs.
Smokeless flame supplies an adverse consequence after which the refrain still appears.
Recognition through trace makes guilt identifiable.
A visible mark makes exposure immediate.
Being taken to account turns disclosed truth into consequence.
Falsehood against truth anchors warning back to the focus denial.

structural_cues: The refrain follows 55:26-27 and recurs after the adverse scenes at 55:35, 55:37, 55:39, 55:41, and 55:43-44, not only after gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mortality, permanence, punishment, recognition, and accountability; I infer that truthful warning is protective disclosure and can belong among the ālāʾ. It may instead be a sign of sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: Ālāʾ denotes only immediately pleasant gifts.
changed_reading.after: Ālāʾ can include severe disclosure of limits and consequences that makes continued self-deception impossible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Petition, daily effective action, continuing flow, gushing springs, and stable growing good transform favors from static inventory into maintained processes. Denial erases the maintenance behind apparent stability.

activation_trace.role: Continuing provision makes flow an ongoing supply rather than a stored object.
Petition positions creatures as recurrent recipients.
Effective repair gives each day's affair a maintenance function.
A running-water source materializes sustained origination.
Abundant welling water intensifies active renewal.
Stable growing good closes the surah with generative persistence.
Nurture, repair, and completion join the flows into one focus mechanism.

structural_cues: 55:29 places universal asking beside activity renewed every day; the paired springs of 55:50 and 55:66 flow and gush.
The final verse names enduring increase immediately after the last refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent asking, daily action, flowing sources, and stable growth; I infer that stability is produced by continued lordly maintenance. These may instead be discrete gifts.

changed_reading.before: The pair is asked to acknowledge a completed list of possessions.
changed_reading.after: The pair is asked which continuously renewed acts of nurture they will misdescribe as self-sustaining facts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Interspace can separate or connect, counterparts meet, kinds occur as pairs, and groups face one another. The dual address therefore supports relational accountability: how two orders meet, remain distinct, and answer together.

activation_trace.role: The interval between entities supplies space in which a pair stays distinct.
Counterparts arriving face-to-face supply encounter rather than numerical duality.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart makes pairing relational.
A group facing one another supplies mutual answerability.
The dual declaration makes truth-response shared by both parties.

structural_cues: Dual forms proliferate around two risings and settings, two seas, paired produce, two gardens, and two addressee classes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring pairs, encounter, interval, and facing; I infer that the grammatical dual carries relational accountability. It may only identify two classes.

changed_reading.before: Two independent recipients happen to receive the same question.
changed_reading.after: The two are co-witnesses whose truthfulness is tested in encounter across maintained difference.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a plant-name branch rather than the dominant favor sense. It remains anchored in the focus inventory and is awakened by seed, husk, and aromatic vegetation immediately before 55:13. Render it only as a botanical afterimage complicating how favor is tasted, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 2 supplies a beautiful-looking, bitter-tasting shrub branch; the interrogative and denial permit a challenge to surface valuation.

activation_trace.role: An attractive but bitter shrub supplies value whose surface and taste diverge.
Germinating seed establishes the agricultural field activating the plant image.
Husk adds the less palatable remainder belonging to nourishment.
Aromatic vegetation supplies the pleasant sensory counterpoint.

changed_reading.before: Every favor is immediately sweet and transparent in value.
changed_reading.after: Some nurture may look beautiful yet taste bitter, so rejection can expose a shallow criterion for benefit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines remainder and last-breath branches from the non-dominant mapped root. It remains anchored by the supplied split inventory and is activated by the later extinction/abiding pair. Render it as temporal and juridical resonance, not direct etymology or lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun at word 2 carries branches for a following remainder and last breath; words 3-4 keep the resonance a lordly claim tested by response.

activation_trace.role: A remainder after what came before supplies a claim surviving earlier acts.
The last-breath branch places that claim at creaturely duration's edge.
Staying and lasting attach persistence to the Lord relation.
A charge proving false by failure makes the residual claim testable.
Passing away activates the terminal edge of the model.
What remains after loss mirrors a surviving remainder.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns benefits in the present scene.
changed_reading.after: It faintly asks what lordly claim still follows the pair when their own continuance reaches its last breath.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a cloth idiom from the denial root into truth response. It remains anchored in تُكَذِّبَانِ and gains a material echo from later patterned furnishing. Render it as analogy for cosmetic falsification, not the verb's contextual translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The denial verb at word 4 has a branch for deceptive variegated cloth; the favor noun at word 2 directs the analogy toward misrepresenting a real gift.

activation_trace.role: Deceptively patterned cloth images falsehood as an attractive overlay.
A genuine bestowed favor supplies the underlying reality being redescribed.
Precious patterned furnishings provide a genuine surface against which deceptive patterning differs.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a flat negative proposition.
changed_reading.after: Denial can lay an attractive interpretive pattern over a gift until its source and claim disappear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates pastoral milk idioms in the focus roots. It remains anchored in the supplied failure-of-milk and post-birth nurture branches and is activated by later continuous and gushing provision. Render it only as material analogy for denied supply, not as a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus denial verb at word 4 supplies failed expected milk, and the Lord root at word 3 supplies freshness after birth and milk-oriented care.

activation_trace.role: Milk failing expectation recasts denial as a verdict that provision failed.
Post-birth freshness and milk care supply dependent nurture.
Continuing provision counters the verdict that supply ceased.
Abundant welling water intensifies evidence of active supply.

changed_reading.before: The pair denies by contradicting a statement.
changed_reading.after: The pair may deny by treating continuously supplied life as though its source had failed or never supplied it.

strongest_changes: The opening sequence turns denial into under-measuring disclosed evidence, not only refusing gratitude.
The clay/fire parallel resolves the dual as two unlike created orders jointly answerable to one Lord.
Boundaries, warnings, and continuous maintenance enlarge ālāʾ beyond pleasant objects.
Exact recurrence activates a contained antiphonal reading in which each scene demands a renewed paired answer.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots coexist as favor, capacity/shortfall, oath/covenant, failed charge, following right, and answering voice. Whole-surah recurrence successively activates epistemic, legal, relational, temporal, material, and performative readings without collapsing them.
remaining_uncertainties: Sequence, liability, last-breath, and answering-voice readings depend on a non-dominant split mapping and remain exploratory.
Human and jinn are the strongest retrospective resolution of the dual, but the focus alone leaves the pair unspecified.
Warnings may be protective favors or signs of sovereignty.
Botanical, textile, and pastoral outliers are imagistic activations, not lexical replacements.
